description:
[Calculators] Make a Rust key bind command (auto-run, crafting, chat, gestures...). The bind maker page (https://rust.wiki/calculators/bind-maker). Returns the `bind` line to paste into the F1
console and `writecfg` to save it. Without `preset`: every preset with its fields and suggested key, the bind
syntax and the key names.

a.description: The preset's first field (item ID, message, gesture, FOV, or the custom command).

b.description: The preset's second field (craft amount, second FOV).

key.description: Key name, e.g. `x`, `f1`, `mouse3` (default: the preset's suggestion).

modifier.description: Optional held key for a combo: leftshift, leftcontrol, leftalt.

preset.description: What the key does: autorun, sprintjump, crouch, autoattack, light_ads, craft, chat, teamchat, gesture, fov, voice, hoverloot, combatlog, kill, disconnect, custom. Left out = list the presets.

name: make_key_bind
title: Make a Rust key bind command (auto-run, crafting, chat, gestures...)
